adventure.name: The Beginner's Cave
adventure.description: The Beginner's Cave has been set up by the Warlord as a service to all Free Adventurers, giving them a chance to try their skills in a not-too-dangerous setting.
adventure.style_prompt_prefix: Eyvind Earle Sleeping Beauty 1959 style, geometric angular Gothic architecture, jewel-tone palette of deep purples and midnight blues with burnished gold accents, Byzantine and Persian miniature influence, architectural depth with layered planes, painterly backgrounds with light-defined detail, flat graphic characters with subtle shading, Celtic ornamental details
adventure.author: Donald Brown
adventure.intro: You stand at the entrance to a cave. A sign over the entrance reads "Beginners Only!" Your heart quickens as you grip your weapon. Whatever lies within, fame and fortune await the brave — or a quick death awaits the foolish.
adventure.full_description:
Let us all toast the Warlord for restocking the cave daily!

Only beginners are supposed to enter the cave (but any character can). Knight Marshall William Misslefire is on duty to prevent inexperienced adventurers from doing anything really foolish (like entering the cave with no weapon at all!).

To return to the Main Hall, just leave the cave (by getting to the cave entrance and moving north). Once you have done so, Sam Slicker, the local dealer for treasures and booty, will pay you in gold for any items that you have collected (with the price adjusted slightly depending upon your charisma).

CONVERSION NOTES:

This is the true and original Beginner's Cave and actually the first Classic Eamon adventure, written by Donald Brown nearly three decades ago. In an attempt to preserve the flavor of the Classic Eamon experience, very little new content was added upon conversion to Eamon Deluxe conversion. Just the standard Eamon Deluxe enhancements and the addition of a few embedded artifacts which were  already hinted at in the descriptions. Although designed as a simple outing for new characters, the Beginner's Cave captures the unique experience of Eamon very well and is, in many ways, one of the best adventures ever written for it.

characters.name: Rat
characters.description: You see three huge rats charging at you! One is black, one is brown, and one is tan. Each one has sharp white teeth.
characters.first_encounter_text: You see three huge rats charging at you! One is black, one is brown, and one is tan. Each one has sharp white teeth.
characters.portrait_description: Three oversized cave rats with sharp white teeth, one black, one brown, and one tan, charging low through dim torchlight in Eyvind Earle flat graphic style.

characters.name: Priest
characters.description: There is a huge man in religious garb with an insane look on his face here. In his right hand, he carries a mace.
characters.first_encounter_text: There is a huge man in religious garb with an insane look on his face here. In his right hand, he carries a mace.
characters.portrait_description: Huge wild-eyed priest in heavy religious garb gripping a mace, dramatic angular silhouette, Eyvind Earle Sleeping Beauty 1959 style.
characters.captive_intro: A huge, wild-eyed priest in blood-stained robes stands over a stone altar, a curved knife raised above a bound young woman.
characters.persona: A once-gentle temple priest driven mad by years alone among the cave's dark altars. He believes the bloody altar demands a sacrifice. Somewhere beneath the madness he remembers his liturgy, his order, and his shame. He responds to scripture, calm authority, and reminders of who he was; threats and mockery feed the madness.

acts.label: Reason with
acts.success_text: You try to reason with the priest, but logic is a language he no longer speaks. His eyes burn brighter. "The altar HUNGERS," he howls.

acts.label: Pray with
acts.success_text: You raise your voice in the old liturgy — the one painted on these very walls. The priest falters mid-snarl. His lips move with yours, remembering.
acts.repeat_text: You pray again. The mace droops in his hand; tears cut clean lines down his filthy face.

telegraph.name: overhead blow
telegraph.warn_text: The priest raises his mace high overhead, shrieking a broken litany — a crushing blow is coming!

characters.yield_text: The mad light gutters out of the priest's eyes. The mace clatters to the stone and he sinks to his knees before the bloody altar, mumbling the old words. The fight is over, if you will let it be.
characters.spare_text: You lower your weapon. The priest unbinds Cynthia with shaking hands and presses his temple purse upon you, weeping. "The altar is fed enough," he whispers, and begins, slowly, to scrub the old blood from the stone.

characters.name: Cynthia
characters.description: You see a beautiful girl in a flowing white dress. You recognize her as Cynthia Luxom, Duke Luxom's not-too-bright daughter.
characters.first_encounter_text: You see a beautiful girl in a flowing white dress. You recognize her as Cynthia Luxom, Duke Luxom's not-too-bright daughter.
characters.dialogue: Cynthia gazes at you with wide, vacant eyes, then brightens. "Oh! Have you come to take me home? Father — Duke Luxom — will reward you ever so handsomely if you see me safely out of this dreadful cave."
characters.portrait_description: Beautiful young noblewoman in a flowing white dress, innocent expression, jewel-tone shadows and Celtic ornamental trim, Eyvind Earle flat graphic style.
characters.persona: Duke Luxom's sweet, sheltered, not-too-bright daughter, kidnapped by the mad priest and frightened half out of her wits. She chatters when nervous, dotes on her rescuer, and is endearingly literal-minded. She knows only what she has seen: the priest, the temple, and the long dark walk from the cave mouth.

characters.name: Hermit
characters.description: There is a grizzled old hermit (who smells as if he hasn't taken a bath in forty years) in the room.
characters.first_encounter_text: There is a grizzled old hermit (who smells as if he hasn't taken a bath in forty years) in the room.
characters.dialogue: The old hermit fixes you with a rheumy eye. "Glory-seekers, the lot of you. Heed an old man: not every chest in these caves wants opening — some have teeth."
characters.portrait_description: Grizzled old hermit with tangled hair and weathered clothes, carrying an axe, wary neutral stance, Eyvind Earle flat graphic style.
characters.persona: A grizzled hermit who has lived alone in this cave for forty years and likes it that way. Cantankerous, suspicious of glory-seekers, but lonely underneath and full of hard-won cave wisdom. Plain speech, honesty, and good listening win him over; flattery and bravado bore him.

acts.label: Apologize to
acts.success_text: You lower your weapon and say, plainly, that you meant no harm trespassing in his home. The hermit's axe-arm eases. "Hmph. Forty years, and that's the first apology these walls have heard."

characters.yield_text: The hermit plants his axe-head on the stone and leans on it, studying you with one rheumy eye. "Well. Maybe you're not like the others."
characters.spare_text: The hermit spits on his palm and offers his hand. "You'll do. Stay close — I know every crack of this cave, and most of what's hungry in it."

characters.name: Gorilla
characters.description: There is a huge, hairy, strong and angry gorilla in the room with you!
characters.first_encounter_text: There is a huge, hairy, strong and angry gorilla in the room with you!
characters.portrait_description: Huge angry gorilla with heavy shoulders and clenched fists, dark fur against dim cavern light, Eyvind Earle flat graphic style.
characters.persona: A frightened wild animal, not a monster: dragged into this cave and locked in a cell it does not understand. It cannot speak and does not understand words, only tone — softness, stillness, and open hands. Sudden moves and shouting terrify it into violence.

acts.label: Calm
acts.success_text: You lower your weapon, open your empty palms, and hum low and steady. The gorilla's screaming stops. It watches your hands, knuckles still planted, breathing hard.
acts.repeat_text: You keep your palms open and your voice low. The great shoulders drop an inch. It huffs — wary, but no longer wild.

acts.label: Posture at
acts.success_text: You beat your chest and roar back at it. Bad idea. The gorilla's answering bellow shakes dust from the ceiling.

telegraph.name: charge
telegraph.warn_text: The gorilla rears to its full height and beats its chest — it is about to charge!

characters.yield_text: The gorilla backs against the cell wall, hooting softly, one long arm curled over its head. It does not want to fight you. It never did.
characters.spare_text: You step back and leave the doorway clear. The gorilla watches you a long moment — then knuckles past you, unhurried, and settles in the far corner with its back to the wall. Something like peace returns to the little cell.

characters.name: Heinrich
characters.description: A human warrior stands before you, armed with a longsword and carrying a shield. On his shield is a sticker which says, "Hi, I'm Heinrich!"
characters.first_encounter_text: A human warrior stands before you, armed with a longsword and carrying a shield. On his shield is a sticker which says, "Hi, I'm Heinrich!"
characters.dialogue: Heinrich grins and thumps his shield. "Well met, friend! Heinrich Schmidt, at your service. Stick close and watch your flank — these tunnels have chewed up better than you and me both."
characters.portrait_description: Human warrior with longsword and shield bearing a Hi, I am Heinrich sticker, neutral mercenary expression, Eyvind Earle flat graphic style.
characters.persona: A cheerful journeyman sellsword, more salesman than killer — he literally wears a name-tag sticker on his shield. Professional about violence, never personal. He respects courtesy, good humor, and sensible deals; if he has drawn steel on you it is strictly business, and he would honestly rather not.

acts.label: Apologize to
acts.success_text: "Whoa, whoa." You raise an open hand and tell Heinrich this fight is a misunderstanding. He peers at you over his shield rim. "Huh. You know, you don't LOOK like the usual cave riffraff."

characters.yield_text: Heinrich steps back and lowers his longsword with a professional nod. "Tell you what — no hard feelings, eh? Steel's expensive and you seem decent."
characters.spare_text: Heinrich sheathes his sword with a flourish and thumps your shoulder. "Heinrich Schmidt, at your service after all! Stick with me, friend — two blades walk farther than one."

characters.name: Mimic
characters.description: A chest-shaped monster is in the room, holding you with two tentacles and attempting to disassemble you with a third one.
characters.first_encounter_text: A chest-shaped monster is in the room, holding you with two tentacles and attempting to disassemble you with a third one.
characters.portrait_description: Chest-shaped monster with grasping tentacles and jagged lid-mouth, lurking in dim cell shadows, Eyvind Earle flat graphic style.
characters.persona: A mimic disguised as a wooden chest, very hungry and very bad at small talk. If spoken to while disguised it answers in a muffled, woody voice, pretending unconvincingly to be ordinary furniture ('I am a normal chest. Chests do not talk. Please come closer.'). It cannot resist replying, which is its great weakness as an ambush predator.

characters.name: Pirate
characters.description: You see a man with a beard and a brass ring in his ear. He is wearing clothes made out of silk and is wielding a very fancily engraved sword.
characters.first_encounter_text: You see a man with a beard and a brass ring in his ear. He is wearing clothes made out of silk and is wielding a very fancily engraved sword.
characters.portrait_description: Bearded pirate with brass earring and silk clothes, wielding an ornate sword named TrollsFire, windswept cove backdrop, Eyvind Earle flat graphic style.
characters.persona: A vain, theatrical old corsair marooned in this cove with his beloved engraved sword TrollsFire and a rotting boat. He is a coward at heart who masks fear with swagger. He respects flattery of his legend, fair bargains, and anyone who can out-talk him; he despises being laughed at. He desperately wants to leave this cave but will not admit it.

acts.label: Parley with
acts.success_text: "Parley, is it?" The pirate's blade dips a hand's width. "Aye... I know the old code. Speak your piece, landlubber, and speak it pretty."
acts.repeat_text: The pirate leans on a rock, sword loose in his grip, half-enjoying the negotiation. "Go on. I'm listening."

acts.label: Taunt
acts.success_text: You laugh at his silk clothes and his broken little boat. The pirate's face goes scarlet. "INSOLENT DOG!" Vanity is the one thing he'll fight for.

characters.yield_text: The pirate staggers back against his ruined boat, sword point dropping to the sand. "Hold — HOLD, devil take you!" he pants. "Perhaps... perhaps we needn't finish this dance."
characters.spare_text: The pirate stares at you, then barks a disbelieving laugh. "Mercy, from a guild rat! Ha!" He unbuckles TrollsFire, scabbard and all, and presses it into your hands with his coin purse. "Take her — she's brought me nothing but grief. And tell them ashore that One-Eyed Filmore paid his debts." He shoves his wretched boat toward the waves.

items.name: diamonds
items.description: You see a large pile of gleaming diamonds here!

items.name: axe
items.description: You see a standard Marcos axe here.

items.name: healing potion
items.description: There is a bottle with a strange potion inside of it here! It has a label stuck to it that you could READ.

items.name: chest
items.description: A sturdy iron-bound chest sits against the wall, its lid shut.

items.name: sword
items.description: There is a poor quality Marcos sword here.

items.name: sack of coins
items.description: You find a sack with 50 gold coins inside!

items.name: spices
items.description: You find several spices. They are of a rare variety and quite valuable.

items.name: glowing book
items.description: There is an old book here. It glows in the darkness and is remarkably well preserved.
items.text: The book contains ancient lore about the cave's history. It is of great scholarly value.
items.effect_description: Readable lore item; contains ancient scholarship about the cave.
items.read_effect_text: You open the glowing book and read its first line aloud. The air shivers — your arms fuse to your sides, your skin runs to silver scales, and you drop to the cold stone a tiny gasping fish. There is no water here. You suffocate on dry rock within moments.

read_effect_text_at.26: You read the glowing book aloud at the water's edge. You shrink to a tiny silver fish and flop — by sheer dumb luck — into the sea! For one triumphant instant you think you've cheated the curse... then a passing gull plucks you from the waves and swallows you whole. An amusing, and rather sticky, end.

items.name: TrollsFire
items.description: The Pirate was carrying a beautiful sword. Carved on the hilt, in intricate detail, is the sword's name, "TrollsFire".

items.name: jewels
items.description: There is a large pile of jewels here!

items.name: inscription
items.description: You see an inscription on the wall which reads, "You needn't gather treasure one piece at a time. Type TAKE ALL (or GET ALL) to scoop up everything loose in a room at once. Fixtures, the fallen, and signs like this one stay where they are."

items.name: inscription
items.description: An inscription on the wall reads, "Two ways to act, traveller: tap one of the choices below, or simply type what you wish to do. Capital letters and small make no difference here."

items.name: inscription
items.description: Written on the wall are the words, "To walk a passage, name its direction — or just its first letter. N, S, E, W carry you north, south, east and west; U and D, up and down."

items.name: writing
items.description: You see some words chiseled into the wall: "You are not bound to the buttons. In the box below you may type a command in your own words — MOVE WEST, ATTACK THE RAT, READ THE WALL — then press Send."

items.name: inscription
items.description: There are some words written here: "Lost your bearings? Type LOOK and the chamber will tell you again what lies within it, who shares it with you, and where its passages lead."

items.name: writing
items.description: You see some words carved into the wall: "Change your weapon with the READY command (e.g., READY SWORD). Don armour or a shield with WEAR, and take them off with REMOVE. Should you find a finer blade in the dark, ready it at once."

items.name: scroll
items.description: You unfurl a scroll from among the pirate's effects. In a hurried hand it reads: "Stranger — there is no deeper door in this cave, only the way you entered. When your satchel is heavy and your wounds will bear no more, make for the Cave Entrance and head NORTH. Sam Slicker will weigh your plunder into gold and the Guild will mark the deed done. But fall here, or never leave, and you carry nothing home."

items.name: loose flagstone
items.description: You work your fingers under the loose flagstone and lever it up. Beneath it, scratched into the rock, is a shallow hollow — some prisoner's secret hiding place.

items.name: silver coins
items.description: A small twist of cloth holds a handful of tarnished silver coins — a prisoner's hidden savings, never spent.

items.name: chest
items.description: A wooden chest sits invitingly against the cavern wall, its lid slightly ajar.

items.name: gold ring
items.description: A heavy gold ring lies among the mimic's remains.
